summary: path_join joins path components; if a component is absolute, all previous components are discarded.
questions: How do I build a file path from parts in Ansible?
Why does path_join drop the first part of my path?

answer_card.title: path_join filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ ['/etc', 'subdir', file] | path_join }}` joins path components. If any component is an **absolute** path, all components before it are ignored and joining continues from there.
